content.title: These Stocks Moved the Most Today: Nvidia, Tesla, Nike, DJT, Hecla, Newmont, Corcept, Vanda, and More
content.summary: FEATURE  Stocks fell Wednesday, the last trading day in what has been a strong year for Wall Street. These stocks made notable moves:  Nvidia  fell 0.6%. The chip maker’s stock recently has been hit by fears of competition from rival hardware but the prospect of resumed sales in China could point the way to future gains for the shares.

content.title: Stocks to Watch Tuesday: Boeing, Meta, Applied Digital, Pop Mart
content.summary: ↗️ Applied Digital (APLD): The artificial-intelligence infrastructure provider plans to spin out its cloud business and combine it with EKSO Bionics (EKSO). Shares in Applied Digital closed down 2.9%, while EKSO shares surged 94%.

content.title: Tesla expects weak Q4 deliveries, Boeing's $8.6B contract with Israel
content.description:
Yahoo Finance executive editor Brian Sozzi tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including Tesla's (TSLA) expectations for weaker EV deliveries in the fourth quarter of 2025, mining company stocks gaining on the rebound in silver (SI=F), gold (GC=F), and copper prices (HG=F), and Boeing (BA) signing an $8.5 billion contract with the US Air Force to build fighter jets for the Israeli military.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Morning Brief.
